Help.ActivityConfig: Create one persistent zone, or enable zone parts to create several logical zones from the same placement.
Help.Multipart: In single-zone mode, the Triggers below apply to one zone. With zone parts enabled, each part has its own Triggers; Movement, Linked Walls, and Linked Lights remain general placement settings.
Help.MainGeometry: Defines the shape created by the main placement. Distances use the scene's distance units.
Help.CircleRadius: Distance from the center to the edge of the zone, in scene units.
Help.RectangleDimensions: Width and height are stored with the selected unit and converted to the current scene when placed. The chosen point is the rectangle's center.
Help.RingReferenceRadius: Distance from the center to the reference line used to position the ring, in scene units.
Help.RingInnerWidth: Distance the ring extends inward from the reference radius, in scene units.
Help.RingOuterWidth: Distance the ring extends outward from the reference radius, in scene units.
Help.LegacyRingInnerWidth: Contribution to the legacy ring's total thickness, in scene units. The reference-radius mode positions the combined thickness.
Help.LegacyRingOuterWidth: Contribution to the legacy ring's total thickness, in scene units. The reference-radius mode positions the combined thickness.
Help.RingRadiusMode: Chooses which part of the band matches the reference radius: its outer edge, centerline, or inner edge.
Help.WallLength: Length of the placed wall segment, in scene units.
Help.WallThickness: Width of the persistent zone around the placed wall segment, in scene units.
Help.Parts: Zone parts divide one persistent placement into several logical zones that may react differently.
Help.PartLabel: Visible name used to identify this part in the editor and diagnostics.
Help.PartRole: Descriptive classification only; Primary does not give a part mechanical priority over Secondary.
Help.PartGeometry: Use the main placement, or create a band beside a compatible line or ring part.
Help.ReferencePart: Previous part whose geometry is used to position this band.
Help.PartGap: Empty distance between the reference part's edge and the beginning of this band, in scene units.
Help.PartWidth: Width of the new band after the gap, in scene units.
Help.LineSide: Left and right are determined by the direction in which the wall was drawn.
Help.RingSide: Inner extends toward the center; Outer extends away from the center.
Help.PartTriggers: These triggers apply only to this zone part.
Help.TriggersSingle: Determines what happens when a token interacts with this zone.
Help.TriggerCreate: Occurs once for each token already inside the zone after its Region is fully created.
Help.TriggerFrequencyGroup: Triggers using the same group share the once-per-turn limit. The limit applies during an active combat; outside combat, the trigger remains unlimited.
Help.TriggerEnter: Occurs when a token crosses from outside into the zone.
Help.TriggerMove: Occurs while a movement remains within the zone, using the configured movement step rules; it is not necessarily applied once per grid space.
Help.TriggerExit: Occurs when a token crosses from inside to outside the zone.
Help.TriggerTurnStart: Occurs at the start of a token's turn while it is inside the zone.
Help.TriggerTurnEnd: Occurs at the end of a token's turn while it is inside the zone.
Help.Save: If enabled, the configured saving throw is resolved before the simple effect.
Help.SaveResult: Choose whether a successful save halves damage or prevents the simple effect.
Help.Statuses: Applies the selected status and controls whether it remains after the token leaves the zone.
Help.StatusRecovery: Optionally allows a saving throw at the end of the affected creature's turn to remove the status.
Help.LinkedActivity: Runs another activity from this item when this trigger occurs.
Help.Movement: General placement setting: controls whether qualifying entry or movement can interrupt token movement across the Persistent Zone.
Help.LinkedWalls: Creates Foundry walls from the main placement geometry. Preset, geometry, direction, proximity, and custom restrictions apply globally to this placement.
Help.LinkedLights: Creates Foundry lights from the main placement geometry. Their layout and limits apply globally, not separately to each zone part.
Help.TerrainRuntimePending: Stores a terrain request for legacy activity data without enabling runtime difficult terrain.
Help.TerrainZone: Difficult terrain doubles movement cost in this zone according to the D&D5e rules.
Help.TerrainPart: Difficult terrain doubles movement cost in this zone part according to the D&D5e rules.
